25-jaar-judoclub-michigami.title: 25 Years of Judoclub Michigami
25-jaar-judoclub-michigami.content:
This year Judoclub Michigami turns 25! We celebrated that with a judo tournament on 6 October. It was a wonderful day and the participants went home with lovely prizes. A big thank you once again to all the volunteers for their help.
Our judoka all managed to pick up a nice prize too:

1st place: Tobias Plasmans, Robert Dingenouts
2nd place: Yves Harmsen, Siep van der Pligt, Renske van den Berg
3rd place: Tycho Glandorf, Nena van Roosendaal
4th place: Cosette Harmsen, Kjeld Glandorf

zomervakantie-2018.title: Summer holiday 2018 is over
zomervakantie-2018.content: On Friday 24 August the judo lessons finally start again. I hope you all had a lovely holiday and are full of energy to get stuck in again — see you on Friday!

paastoernooi-uitslag.title: Easter tournament results
paastoernooi-uitslag.content: Some of our judoka were also in action at the OVJV Easter tournament on 32 March. Amelie and Yves Harmsen went home with 2nd prize. Cosette Harmsen and Tobias Plasmans took 3rd place. A fine performance!

toernooi-yukio-tani-huijbergen.title: Yukio Tani Tournament Huijbergen
toernooi-yukio-tani-huijbergen.content: Once again all our judoka went home with a prize at the Yukio Tani Tournament in Huijbergen. With 1st place for Cosette Harmsen, 2nd place for Yves Harmsen, Amelie Harmsen and Kian van Dorst, and 3rd place for Kjeld Glandorf and Tycho Glandorf. Congratulations!

cjjf-bondskampioenschappen-bergen-op-zoo.title: CJJF National Championships Bergen op Zoom
cjjf-bondskampioenschappen-bergen-op-zoo.content:
Last Saturday 3 March saw the first of the four national championships of 2018, held in Bergen op Zoom. Judoclub Michigami was represented by 6 judoka. They all went home with a beautiful trophy, so another great result!

3rd place: Amelie Harmsen, Kjeld Glandorf
2nd place: Cosette Harmsen
1st place: Yves Harmsen, Tycho Glandorf, Robert Dingenouts

Four national championships are held this year; at the end of the year it is determined who the champions are in each category, and the judoka then stand a chance of winning a large travelling trophy.

witte-gele-banden-toernooi-heerle.title: White and yellow belt tournament Heerle
witte-gele-banden-toernooi-heerle.content: On Saturday 19 November, Judovereniging Garami in Heerle organised the white and yellow belt tournament. Lots of young judoka came along from the Netherlands, Belgium and England. Our judoka from Michigami did very well and won many prizes. Siep van der Pligt was in a very strong pool and, after a real battle, finished 4th. Kjeld and Tycho Glandorf both went home with 3rd place. Cosette and Amelie Harmsen and Kian van Dorst took 2nd place. Brenden Snel and Tobias Plasman won all their matches and took 1st place. We are proud of you!

3e-dan-geslaagd.title: Michigami Judoka/Coaches Pass 3rd Dan
3e-dan-geslaagd.content: On Saturday 4 June the CJJF Dan exams were taken in Steenbergen at the Knotwilg. After a long period of hard training, 4 Michigami judoka — Robin Hack, Pascal Hack, Robert Dingenouts and John Kok — went up for their 3rd dan. All 4 passed, and it was noted that the level among all the candidates was once again very high this year.

budo-kidsdag.title: BUDO Kids Day/Budo Day
budo-kidsdag.content: On Saturday 5 March we organised the Budo Kids Day/Budo Day together with the CJJF in the Knotwilg, Steenbergen. Children and adults received lessons in various Budo/martial sports. Everyone enjoyed it and it was a great day!

rabo-clubsupport-2026.title: 🗳️ Support Judoclub Michigami in Rabo ClubSupport 2026!
rabo-clubsupport-2026.content:
It's that time of year again: the Rabo ClubSupport voting period is open! 💙🧡

From 7 to 29 September you can vote for your favourite clubs again. And of course Judoclub Michigami is taking part again this year!

Every vote brings us one step closer to our club goals. Are you a Rabobank customer? Then don't forget to cast your vote for us via the Rabo App (Settings > Membership > Rabo ClubSupport).

Will you help out?

• Cast your own vote for Judoclub Michigami!
• Also ask your family members, relatives, friends and neighbours to vote for us.

Did you know that you can already vote from age 12 (with permission from a parent/guardian in the app via Parental supervision)?

The results will be known between 5 and 16 October. Thank you so much in advance for your support! Together we'll make Michigami even stronger! 💪🥋

gratis-inschrijven-actie-2026.title: 🎁 Promotion: free registration before 31 December!
gratis-inschrijven-actie-2026.content:
We have great news! If you register with Judoclub Michigami before 31 December 2026, you pay no €15 registration fee. That way you can still start judo at a bargain this year! 🥋

How does it work?

1️⃣ Sign up for a free trial lesson via the 'Trial lesson' button on our website.
2️⃣ Come along to 3 free trial lessons and experience for yourself what judo does for you.
3️⃣ Enjoying it? Then register before 31 December and save yourself the €15 registration fee!

For everyone from 6 years old — from child to adult. We train on Wednesday evenings in Oud-Vossemeer (De Vossenkuil) and Friday evenings in Steenbergen (Sportcentrum de Knotwilg).

We do this in cooperation with Sportcentrum de Knotwilg Steenbergen. Come along, we'll see you on the mat! 🙌

examenresultaten-februari-2026.title: Exam results — great progress! 🎉
examenresultaten-februari-2026.content:
Hard work and perseverance pay off. We are proud of the great progress our judoka showed last week:

⚪ 4x White belt
🟡 3x Yellow slip
🟡 5x Yellow belt
🟠 2x Orange slip
🟠 2x Orange belt
🟢 3x Green slip

Congratulations everyone! 🎉

lintjestoernooi-februari-2026.title: Ribbon Tournament — Mika, Lotte, Vive and Luuk!
lintjestoernooi-februari-2026.content:
Yesterday Mika, Lotte, Vive and Luuk fought hard again and gained lots of experience at the Ribbon Tournament. They all did really well and scored good points with throws and holds.

The points scored:
🥋 Vive — 174
🥋 Lotte — 61
🥋 Mika — 59
🥋 Luuk — 40

Yesterday Mika and Luuk earned their yellow ribbon, congratulations!

The next edition is on 8 March.

teun-gele-slip-augustus-2025.title: Teun passes his yellow slip — kept going after surgery! 💪
teun-gele-slip-augustus-2025.content: Before the holidays Teun had to postpone his exam because of an operation, but yesterday he made up for it: he passed his yellow slip! 🥋💪 Congratulations Teun! #keepgoing

14-judoka-examen-juni-2025.title: 14 judoka — all passed! 🔥
14-judoka-examen-juni-2025.content:
Last evening 14 judoka took their belt or slip exam — and all passed! 💪 They had to work up a sweat for it… literally! It was so fierce that steam was coming off the mat 🔥

Well done, champions, you've earned it! 🥳

witte-banden-mei-2025.title: Champions pass the white belt! 🥋
witte-banden-mei-2025.content: These champions showed yesterday that they have mastered the basics of judo! All passed for the white belt. The quality was visible: you could tell that they had been practising extra. Proud of our judoka! 💪

lola-witte-band-2025.title: Lola passes the White Belt!
lola-witte-band-2025.content: And Lola also passed the White Belt! 🥋 Excellent exam, thoroughly deserved! 💪

spelletjesdag-februari-2025.title: Games day at Judoclub Michigami! 🎲
spelletjesdag-februari-2025.content: The last training before the holidays is usually games day at our club! We then play all sorts of games to do with judo, speed and reaction skills. For example, last year before the Christmas holidays we played our very own judo snakes and ladders board, designed by Robin Hack.

lintjestoernooi-januari-2025.title: First Ribbon Tournament of 2025 — Proud of our judoka!
lintjestoernooi-januari-2025.content:
Today the first Ribbon Tournament of 2025 took place at Budoschool Cor Schuurbiers in Roosendaal. Our judoka fought hard and gained lots of experience.

Proud of our judoka! Last Sunday they again put in some great performances on the mat.

examen-resultaten-januari-2025.title: Proud of our judoka — Exam results
examen-resultaten-januari-2025.content:
Hard work and perseverance pay off. We are proud of the great progress our judoka showed last week:

⚪ 4x White belt
🟡 3x Yellow slip
🟠 2x Orange belt
🟢 3x Green slip

Congratulations everyone! These results are thoroughly deserved after months of hard training.

examen-februari-2025.title: Two judoka passed — yellow slip, yellow belt and orange belt!
examen-februari-2025.content:
Yesterday there were exams again! Two judoka earned their yellow slip, one the yellow belt and one even the orange belt!

And Lola also passed the White Belt! Excellent exam — thoroughly deserved!

Congratulations to everyone who passed!

vriendjesdag-september-2025.title: Friends' Day 2025 — Come try judo for free!
vriendjesdag-september-2025.content: Come and join in the fun with us on Friday evening! During Friends' Day you are welcome to come and try a judo lesson for free. The first 3 lessons are free for new members. Come along to Sportcentrum de Knotwilg in Steenbergen or De Vossenkuil in Oud-Vossemeer!

rabo-clubsupport-september-2025.title: ✨ Rabo ClubSupport 2025 — Vote for Judoclub Michigami!
rabo-clubsupport-september-2025.content:
It's that time of year again! Judoclub Michigami is taking part in Rabo ClubSupport. Vote between 1 and 23 September via the Rabo App and support our club!

Open the Rabo App → Go to Membership > Rabo ClubSupport → Vote for Judoclub Michigami.

lintjestoernooi-mika-lotte-vive-luuk-202.title: Mika, Lotte, Vive and Luuk — Ribbon Tournament results
lintjestoernooi-mika-lotte-vive-luuk-202.content:
Yesterday Mika, Lotte, Vive and Luuk fought hard again and gained lots of experience at the Ribbon Tournament. They all did really well!

The points scored:
• Vive — 174 points
• Lotte — 61 points
• Mika — 59 points
• Luuk — 40 points

Yesterday Mika and Luuk earned their yellow ribbon, congratulations! The next edition is on 8 March. Would you like to take part too? Register via: https://budoschool-corschuurbiers.nl/3-3/

laatsteseizoen-spelletjesdag-examens-202.title: Last judo lesson of the season — Games day + Exams!
laatsteseizoen-spelletjesdag-examens-202.content:
The last judo lesson of the season was not only a lovely games day, but also the moment for a couple of belated exams!

Two judoka earned their yellow slip, one the yellow belt and one even the orange belt! 💪✨ What a wonderful end to the season — full of dedication and fun.

Every one of them one step closer to that big goal: the black belt 🖤 Keep training, keep growing — you are on the right path. We are proud of your dedication!

Have a great summer everyone and see you after the holidays! 🌞

shintai-jubileumtoernooi-2024.title: Active judo weekend — Shintai jubilee tournament + Ribbon Tournament
shintai-jubileumtoernooi-2024.content:
Last weekend was an active judo weekend for Michigami.

On Friday Teun and Maan earned their white belt diploma.

On Saturday 8 judoka took part in the Shintai jubilee tournament in Halsteren (25th anniversary):
• Jax: 1st place
• Ashley and Lucas: 2nd place
• Damian and Julia: 3rd place
• Lotte and Ivo: 4th place
• Lola: 5th place

On Sunday they gained experience at the Ribbon Tournament — Vive and Ivo earned their first ribbon!

Points standings: Ivo 45, Vive 42, Luuk 24, Jan 18.

18-judoka-examen-december-2024.title: 18 judoka earn a new belt or slip!
18-judoka-examen-december-2024.content:
Last Friday no fewer than 18 judoka earned a new belt or slip. During the exams they showed how hard they have been practising. When the Japanese names were called out, many immediately knew how to demonstrate the right techniques — well done!

We are proud of your dedication and perseverance. Keep it up, on to the next belt or slip!

lintjestoernooi-november-2024.title: Ribbon Tournament Roosendaal — 7 judoka took part!
lintjestoernooi-november-2024.content:
Today seven judoka from Judoclub Michigami took part in the Ribbon Tournament by Cor Schuurbiers in Roosendaal! A great opportunity to gain experience in a relaxed atmosphere.

📊 Points scored:
🥋 Merijn — 13
🥋 Jayden — 16
🥋 Jochem — 18
🥋 Lola — 18
🥋 Jax — 18
🥋 Vive — 21
🥋 Ivo — 21

The next round is scheduled for 8 December.

examens-einde-schooljaar-2024.title: Successful exams — end of the 2024 school year
examens-einde-schooljaar-2024.content: Last evening brought a successful end to the school year with the exams for white belts, yellow slips, yellow belts and one orange belt. Everyone has trained incredibly hard and it showed! The quality was really high — what top performances. We are super proud of you all.

wendy-jansen-1e-dan-2024.title: Wendy Jansen earns her 1st Dan black belt! 🎉
wendy-jansen-1e-dan-2024.content:
A proud moment at judo lesson yesterday evening! Wendy Jansen successfully earned her 1st dan black belt. To show her gratitude, she thanked her senseis, uke and judo partners with self-engraved glasses bearing 'arigato' and a judo illustration. The children all received a bag of sweets or crisps.

Congratulations Wendy! 🥋👏

judo-takeover-video-2024.title: Keep holding on! #judo #takeover
judo-takeover-video-2024.content: Watch our new video on Facebook and Instagram — a fun look behind the scenes at Judoclub Michigami. Come and have a look yourself, or join in a training session!

vriendjesdag-2024.title: Friends' Day 2024
vriendjesdag-2024.content: Come and join in the fun with us on Friday evening! During Friends' Day you are welcome to come and try a judo lesson for free. The first 3 lessons are free for new members. Come along to Sportcentrum de Knotwilg in Steenbergen!

open-clubkampioenschappen-2024.title: Open Club Championships 2024 — What a fantastic evening!
open-clubkampioenschappen-2024.content:
What a fantastic evening at the Open Club Championships 2024! The atmosphere was warm and friendly, with enthusiastic judoka fighting their very best fights. There was plenty of action among the seniors too — we had a great number of judoka who were really battling it out.

The juniors showed brilliant moves during the Open Club Championships 2024 in Steenbergen! Enjoy some of the finest moments and techniques.

Thanks to all participants, parents and volunteers for a successful tournament!

rabo-clubsupport-september-2024.title: ✨ Rabo ClubSupport — Vote for Judoclub Michigami!
rabo-clubsupport-september-2024.content:
It's that time of year again! Judoclub Michigami is taking part in Rabo ClubSupport. Vote between 1 and 23 September via the Rabo App and support our club!

Open the Rabo App → Go to Membership > Rabo ClubSupport → Vote for Judoclub Michigami.

chocolade-trainers-2024.title: The coaches were spoiled with chocolate judogi 🍫
chocolade-trainers-2024.content: The coaches were spoiled by a creative judoka with a delicious bar of chocolate, beautifully wrapped up as a judogi. What a lovely and thoughtful surprise! Thank you for this nice little gift.

sinterklaas-video-2024.title: An important message from Sinterklaas! 🎅
sinterklaas-video-2024.content: Sinterklaas has been visiting Judoclub Michigami! Watch the video on our Facebook page for an important message to all judoka. Sinterklaas reminds everyone to keep training and to do their best!

cjjf-kata-training-2024.title: CJJF Kata and technical training in our dojo
cjjf-kata-training-2024.content: Yesterday the CJJF Kata and technical training took place in our dojo. It was a wonderful occasion to reconnect with other judoka from CJJF Budo, to learn from one another and, for some, to train hard for the upcoming Dan grade (black belt) exams.

nieuwe-matten-vriendjesdag-2024.title: New mats — thanks to a donation from Kruisbeek!
nieuwe-matten-vriendjesdag-2024.content:
What a wonderful week for Judoclub Michigami Steenbergen! After saving for years and thanks to a donation, we were able to purchase these new mats. We tested them straight away with a fun, well-attended friends' training.

Special thanks to the now-closed skating rink de Kruisbeek for their donation. You have helped us enormously!

We would also like to thank Bas Carwash Team, Hans Dingenouts, Robert Dingenouts, Robin Hack and Pascal Hack for hauling, cleaning and laying the new mats.

paastoernooi-uitslag-2018.title: Easter tournament results
paastoernooi-uitslag-2018.content: Some of our judoka were also in action at the OVJV Easter tournament on 31 March. Amelie and Yves Harmsen went home with 2nd prize. Cosette Harmsen and Tobias Plasmans took 3rd place. A fine performance!

cjjf-bondskampioenschappen-bergen-op-zoo.title: CJJF National Championships Bergen op Zoom
cjjf-bondskampioenschappen-bergen-op-zoo.content:
Last Saturday 3 March saw the first of the four national championships of 2018, held in Bergen op Zoom. Judoclub Michigami was represented by 6 judoka. They all went home with a beautiful trophy, so another great result!

3rd place: Amelie Harmsen, Kjeld Glandorf
2nd place: Cosette Harmsen
1st place: Yves Harmsen, Tycho Glandorf, Robert Dingenouts

Four national championships are held this year; at the end of the year it is determined who the champions are in each category, and the judoka then stand a chance of winning a large travelling trophy. They are already well on their way!

toernooi-yukio-tani-huijbergen-2018.title: Yukio Tani Tournament Huijbergen
toernooi-yukio-tani-huijbergen-2018.content: Once again all our judoka went home with a prize at the Yukio Tani Tournament in Huijbergen. With 1st place for Cosette Harmsen, 2nd place for Yves Harmsen, Amelie Harmsen and Kian van Dorst, and 3rd place for Kjeld Glandorf and Tycho Glandorf. Congratulations!

cjjf-bondstournooi-michigami-2018.title: CJJF National Tournament at Michigami
cjjf-bondstournooi-michigami-2018.content: This year we helped make it possible for the CJJF national championships to be held in sports hall De Buitelstee in Dinteloord. After a real battle, all our judoka once again took some lovely prizes home!

witte-gele-banden-toernooi-heerle-2017.title: White and yellow belt tournament Heerle
witte-gele-banden-toernooi-heerle-2017.content: On Saturday 19 November, Judovereniging Garami in Heerle organised the white and yellow belt tournament. Lots of young judoka came along from the Netherlands, Belgium and England. Our judoka from Michigami did very well and won many prizes. Siep van der Pligt was in a very strong pool and, after a real battle, finished 4th. Kjeld and Tycho Glandorf both went home with 3rd place. Cosette and Amelie Harmsen and Kian van Dorst took 2nd place. Brenden Snel and Tobias Plasmans won all their matches and took 1st place. We are proud of you!

3e-dan-geslaagd-2017.title: Michigami Judoka/Coaches Pass 3rd Dan
3e-dan-geslaagd-2017.content: On Saturday 4 June the CJJF Dan exams were taken in Steenbergen at the Knotwilg. After a long period of hard training, 4 Michigami judoka — Robin Hack, Pascal Hack, Robert Dingenouts and John Kok — went up for their 3rd dan. All 4 passed, and it was noted that the level among all the candidates was once again very high this year.

budo-kidsdag-budodag-2017.title: BUDO Kids Day/Budo Day
budo-kidsdag-budodag-2017.content: On Saturday 5 March we organised the Budo Kids Day/Budo Day together with the CJJF in the Knotwilg, Steenbergen. Children and adults received lessons in various Budo/martial sports. Everyone enjoyed it and it was a great day!

budo-kidsdag-aankondiging-2016.title: CJJF BUDO Kids Day/Budo Day - Announcement
budo-kidsdag-aankondiging-2016.content:
This year we are once again organising a Budo Kids Day/Budo Day together with the CJJF. On Saturday 5 March everyone is welcome to get acquainted with different Budo sports. For our members it is completely free this year! Just make sure you hand in your registration form on time. You are also welcome to bring family, friends or acquaintances — for non-members under 13 the cost is €5, and from 13 years it is €10.

Participants under 13 are expected at 9.30 in the tennis hall in sportcentrum de Knotwilg. For them it will end at 12.15. At 12.45 the participants aged 13 and over are expected, and that will end at 16.30. We hope you will all be there!

toernooi-yukio-tani-huijbergen-februari-.title: Yukio-Tani Tournament Huijbergen
toernooi-yukio-tani-huijbergen-februari-.content: On Saturday 20 February, 8 judoka from Michigami took part in the beginners' tournament by Yukio-Tani in Huijbergen. The tournament was well organised and our judoka once again took many prizes home. Frederik Colombijn finished 4th. Cosette Harmsen, Sjoerd Uitdewilligen and Ozzy Cools took 3rd place. Jayden van der Have, Yves Harmsen, Bram van der Zanden and Bryan Rombout finished 2nd. Congratulations to you all, very well done!

lestijden-gewijzigd-2016.title: Attention! Lesson times have changed
lestijden-gewijzigd-2016.content: From Friday 8 January 2016, all lessons will start 15 minutes later than we are used to.

yoshi-bergen-op-zoom-2015.title: Yoshi Judo Tournament Bergen op Zoom
yoshi-bergen-op-zoom-2015.content: On Saturday 20 June, our champions from judo club Michigami once again won many prizes at the Yoshi judo tournament in Bergen op Zoom. 4th place was taken three times, by Martijn Noordzij, Sjoerd Uitdewilligen and Sjors van Duijn. Dennis Kamerman took 3rd place. Ricardo den Heijer went home with 2nd prize. And 1st place was won by Latif Nurzad and Robert Dingenouts. Congratulations everyone!

dutch-open-international-2015.title: Michigami successful at the Dutch Open International Championships
dutch-open-international-2015.content: On Saturday 21 March 2015, 4 judoka from judo club Michigami again took part in the Dutch Open International Championships in Dalfsen. The best judoka from the Netherlands and many other countries come here to battle for a place on the podium. The judoka performed very well. Latif Nurzad, Ricardo den Heijer and Damian van Leijenhorst all three took 2nd place. Bernd Engelen also fought well, but unfortunately a small mistake led to his disqualification, which put him in 5th. We are very proud of our judoka — warm congratulations to you all!

shinomaki-loenhout-2015.title: Shinomaki Judo Tournament Loenhout
shinomaki-loenhout-2015.content: On Sunday 8 February, a judo tournament was held in Loenhout by judo club Shinomaki. A few judoka from our club took part. Damian van Leijenhorst took 1st place. Daphne Spruyt and Sjoert Uitdewilligen both took 2nd place. Sjors van Duijn took 3rd place. Congratulations to you all on the prizes won!

budo-kidsdag-imaf-2015.title: CJJF-BUDO / IMAF BUDO KIDS DAY 2015
budo-kidsdag-imaf-2015.content: On Saturday 17 January, the CJJF-BUDO / IMAF BUDO KIDS DAY was held at the Knotwilg in Steenbergen. Children up to and including 12 years old, including a number from judo club Michigami, took part in various activities such as a Vechtbal match, a self-defence course in which you learn how to deal with bullies for example, and a few other activities such as breakfalls and budo reaction games. The children had a great time running around and letting off steam, and at the end they each received a nice souvenir and a big group photo was taken.

kerstvakantie-2014.title: Christmas holidays
kerstvakantie-2014.content:
Friday 19 December is already the last lesson of 2014! On Friday 26 December 2014 and 2 January 2015 there will be no judo lessons. The first lessons of 2015 are on Friday 9 January. We wish you pleasant Christmas days and a fun and healthy judo year.

On behalf of the coaches Koos, Robert, Pascal and Robin.

sinterklaastoernooi-heerle-2014.title: Sinterklaas Tournament Heerle
sinterklaastoernooi-heerle-2014.content: Last Saturday, Judovereniging Garami again organised its annual international Sinterklaas Tournament in Heerle. 6 judoka from Michigami battled for a place on the podium. Sjors van Duijn beat all his opponents and thereby won 1st prize! Frederik Colombijn took 3rd place. Martijn Noordzij, Lorenz Franken and Ricardo den Heijer all finished 4th. Sjoerd Uitdewilligen took 6th place. Congratulations once again to all judoka on the places achieved!

toernooi-bergen-op-zoom-zomer-2014.title: Bergen op Zoom Tournament - Summer Tournament
toernooi-bergen-op-zoom-zomer-2014.content: Last Saturday it was already the last judo tournament before the summer break. 2 judoka from Michigami took 1st place: Ricardo den Heijer and Latif Nurzad. Tim Saarloos took 3rd place. Lamont Sterk finished 4th, Frederik Colombijn 5th and Dennis Kamerman came 6th. Congratulations to you all on the prizes won!

dangraad-examens-2e-dan-2014.title: Michigami Coaches Pass 2nd Dan
dangraad-examens-2e-dan-2014.content: On Saturday 7 June, the C.J.J.F. Dan grade exams were held in Steenbergen. Three judoka/coaches from judo club Michigami sat their exam for the 2nd Dan. Robin Hack took his exam together with Robert Dingenouts, and Pascal Hack with John Kok from judo club Yoshi. For some time now they have been training hard for it at various judo clubs, so the examiners were very pleased with the quality of the exams.

survivalrun-steenbergen-2014.title: Survival Run Steenbergen
survivalrun-steenbergen-2014.content: 5 judoka from Michigami took part in the survival run in Steenbergen. Bruised, soaked and covered in mud, they all reached the finish. Stef van Dijk went solo. Robin Hack, Robert Dingenouts, Pascal Hack and Franco Hack took part in the pairs run. Thanks in part to teamwork, all the obstacles were overcome.

toernooi-stichting-judo-geelhoed-2014.title: Stichting Judo Geelhoed Tournament
toernooi-stichting-judo-geelhoed-2014.content: Lamont Sterk was the only one from Judoclub Michigami present at the Tholen Judo and Vechtbal tournament. Twice Lamont was caught out by his opponents and he eventually reached a shared third place. In Vechtbal he achieved a second place.

slipexamens-april-2014.title: 6 Judoka Pass Slip Exams
slipexamens-april-2014.content: The yellow slip was earned by Quintin v/d Bruggen, Noah v/d Bruggen and Kimberly Otto. The orange slip by Anouk Franken. And a green slip for Tim Saarloos and Ian Ossenblok. Congratulations!

paastoernooi-oud-vossemeer-2014.title: Easter Tournament Oud-Vossemeer
paastoernooi-oud-vossemeer-2014.content: On Saturday 19 April, 4 judoka from JC Michigami took part in the Easter Tournament in Oud Vossemeer and once again won a prize. There was a second place for Frederik Colombijn and Daphne Spruit. Third place went to Lamont Sterk. Mathijs Schrauwen finished fifth.

toernooi-berendrecht-2014.title: Lovely Tournament in Berendrecht for Michigami
toernooi-berendrecht-2014.content:
It was another lovely tournament for Judoclub Michigami, with 3 first, 2 second and 3 third places. For 7 young judoka it was also their very first time competing in a tournament, and they too held their own nicely! Matthijs Schrauwen even won the silver, and Daphne Spruit, Bjorn Ossenblok and Dylan Leijenhorst took home a bronze prize. For the others there was a nice commemorative medal.

The experienced competition judoka also scored well: gold for Marijn van de Berg, Damian Leijenhorst and Latif Nurzad. Silver for Ricardo den Heijer.

vechtbaltoernooi-lamont-2014.title: Vechtbal Tournament - Message from Lamont
vechtbaltoernooi-lamont-2014.content: Hi everyone, I thought the Vechtbal tournament yesterday was brilliant. I won everything. And of course I like the medal the best — I also liked the games we did afterwards. From Lamont

vechtbaltoernooi-22-maart-2014.title: Vechtbal Tournament 22 March 2014
vechtbaltoernooi-22-maart-2014.content: Lamont Sterk was the only one from Judoclub Michigami present at the Tholen Judo and Vechtbal tournament. Twice Lamont was caught out by his opponents and he eventually reached a shared third place. In Vechtbal he achieved a second place.

28-judokas-geslaagd-bandenexamens-2013.title: 28 Judoka Pass Belt Exams
28-judokas-geslaagd-bandenexamens-2013.content:
Over the past months our judoka have been training hard to master all the techniques, and they also had to know the Japanese names. On 29 November the time had come: the belt exam. Of course they were all very nervous, because lots of mums and dads had come to see what they had learned. But despite the nerves, they showed that they had a good command of the techniques — they all did fantastically.

The following judoka all passed:

6th kyu (white belt): Sjoerd Buuron, Sjoerd Uitdewillige, Quintin van de Bruggen, Noah van de Bruggen, Matthijs Schrauwen, Dennes Kamerman, Benjamin Beekman, Daphne Spruyt

5th kyu (yellow belt): Björn Ossenblok, Damian Guldemond, Jeppe Drenth, Thijs Huizer, Sjors van Duijn, Frederik Colombijn, Anouk Franken, Lynn Moerenhout, Giovanni de Meijer, Dylan van Leijenhorst

4th kyu (orange belt): Réno Blaauw, Lucani Spaans, Chiem Geers, Lorenz Franken, Ian Ossenblok, Lamont Sterk, Joeri Ligtenberg, Tim Saarloos

3rd kyu (green belt): Jacco Loos, Kjeld Springer

Once again, congratulations to you all — we are very proud of what you have achieved. On to the next belt!

sinterklaastoernooi-heerle-2013.title: Judoclub Michigami wins lots of prizes again at the Sinterklaas Tournament in Heerle
sinterklaastoernooi-heerle-2013.content: Latif Nurzad took 1st place. In addition, 5 judoka went home with 2nd place: Frederik Colombijn, Ricardo den Heijer, Sjoerd Buuron, Joeri Ligtenberg and Jeppe Drenth. The 3rd prize was won twice, by Björn Ossenblok and Noah van den Bruggen. Bernd Engelen and Matthijs Schrauwen finished 4th. And finally Quintin van der Bruggen and Damian Guldenmond finished 5th. Warm congratulations to all judoka on the prizes won!

tokyokai-toernooi-2013.title: Michigami scored well again at the Tokyokai Judo Tournament
tokyokai-toernooi-2013.content: Our 4 young judoka all performed fantastically. Quintin van de Bruggen took 1st place. Noah van de Bruggen went home with 3rd place. Matthijs Schrauwen and Lamont Sterk both finished 4th. Congratulations!

bandenexamens-november-2013.title: Belt exams November 2013
bandenexamens-november-2013.content: This year we are holding the belt exams on 29 November. Of course those who are not going up for a belt can simply join in the lesson as usual — maybe you'll earn a slip! Parents are very welcome to come and watch. Those of you going up for an exam, do your best!
